why_us.title: The Bol Tortlari Difference
why_us.subtitle: Bringing joy and unforgettable sweetness to your family milestones
why_us.item1_desc: Zero artificial dyes or chemicals: pure cream, Belgian chocolate, and fresh seasonal berries.
why_us.item2_desc: No frozen sponge cakes. Every order is baked fresh for your requested delivery time.
why_us.item3_desc: Signature recipes perfected by award-winning pastry chefs.
why_us.item4_desc: Climate-controlled delivery across Fergana & Uchkuprik to ensure pristine condition.
why_us.item5_desc: We bring any sketch, reference photo, or idea to delectable reality.
why_us.item6_desc: Earn 5% cashback on each order plus referral rewards for inviting friends.

delivery_section.title: Careful Delivery Across Fergana Valley
delivery_section.desc: Because cakes are delicate, we deliver them in custom vehicles equipped with thermo-cooling and secure stabilizing fixtures.
delivery_section.features_card_desc: Your cake will arrive pristine and exactly at the scheduled time
delivery_section.thermo_desc: Optimal temperature control so cream and design never melt.
delivery_section.time_desc: Coordinated to the precise minute your celebration or banquet begins.
delivery_section.box_desc: Vibration-proof shock-absorbing packaging for maximum safety.
delivery_section.respect_desc: Polite and courteous couriers enhancing your celebration mood.

custom_cake.title: Design Your Dream Cake
custom_cake.subtitle: Choose every layer yourself, observe live pricing calculation, and place your order directly online.
custom_cake.step1_title: Step 1: Choose Cake Size and Weight
custom_cake.step1_desc: Select optimal weight based on the number of celebration guests.
custom_cake.step2_desc: Baked fresh using only 100% natural butter, fresh eggs, and premium flour.
custom_cake.step3_desc: Crafted with 82.5% natural heavy cream and Belgian chocolate.
custom_cake.step4_title: Step 4: Select Fruit or Nut Layer Filling
custom_cake.step4_desc: Fresh berry confit or crunchy nut layer between sponges for balanced taste.
custom_cake.step5_desc: Fresh berries, French macarons, or handcrafted chocolate figures.
custom_cake.step6_desc: Artfully hand-piped in chocolate calligraphy by our pastry chef (Free).
custom_cake.greeting_note: Hand-lettered with special chocolate calligraphy free of charge.
